selected_evidence.requirement: Topology built: node2=lan-a(trusted), node3=lan-b(guest), node1 between them
selected_evidence.summary: Discovered second NICs on each node and configured static IPs to form lan-a (192.168.10.0/24, node1 eth1 / node2 ens7) and lan-b (192.168.20.0/24, node1 eth2 / node3 ens7), confirmed by wiring test showing firewall replies before zone rules existed

selected_evidence.requirement: Guest (lan-b) can reach node1's own DNS service
selected_evidence.summary: dnsmasq bound to 192.168.20.1:53 via dhcp.lanb config; node3 successfully resolved openwrt.org via 192.168.20.1 both before and after node1's restart

selected_evidence.requirement: No host on lan-b may open a connection to any host on lan-a
selected_evidence.summary: node3 (guest) ping and TCP connect attempts to node2's lan-a IP (192.168.10.11) were rejected by the firewall (guest zone forward=REJECT) both pre- and post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Trusted hosts (lan-a) keep full access to lan-b in the other direction
selected_evidence.summary: Added lana->lanb forwarding rule and route on node2; node2 successfully pinged and TCP-connected to node3's lan-b IP (192.168.20.12) both pre- and post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 2dffe735 baseline, issued reboot, polled until exec returned new boot_id 36a0a80f, then confirmed ens7 static IP, routes, and trusted->guest/trusted->node1 connectivity all recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id dbb46974 baseline, issued reboot, polled until exec returned new boot_id fc6ed29b, then confirmed ens7 static IP, routes, DNS access, and guest->trusted block all recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 (router) restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state, done last after other nodes healthy
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart UCI/firewall/dnsmasq baseline, issued reboot; boot_id string was unexpectedly unchanged on this OpenWrt image, so used btime/short uptime (336s)/fresh dmesg kernel-boot line as the OS-native proof of a genuine restart; then confirmed eth1/eth2 IPs, lana/lanb UCI network+firewall config, and dnsmasq DNS bindings on both subnets fully persisted, and final end-to-end trusted/guest access rules still held on both other nodes
